06 · Metal adhesion

Barrier performance depends on metal adhesion

With weak adhesion, aluminium detaches during lamination and packing.

Metal transfer→ Micro-cracks→ Barrier loss→ Shorter shelf life
Laboratory scotch test
Scotch test
Aluminium transfers to the tapeGaps in the metal layer reduce the barrier.
Illustration for presentation purposes only
07 · Technology

BOBST AluBond: stronger metal adhesion on CPP

The aluminium layer is anchored to the film chemically, not only physically.

01ActivatePlasma prepares the CPP surface.
02AnchorThe first aluminium atoms bond chemically to the film.
03BuildThe metal layer grows on this anchor.
Higher metal adhesion on CPP
Improved barrier compared with conventional metallising
Longer retention of surface treatment
No chemically primed base film required
Relevance for RusskartMetal adhesion is critical in extrusion lamination and high-speed packing.
08 · Flex metallised CPP

C-CPM-M: metallised CPP for snack laminates

Metallised on the treated side, heat-sealable on the reverse.

Good metal adhesion
Barrier to oxygen, moisture and light
Good seal integrity and hot tack
High-speed runnability on laminators and FFS lines
